Name: Cult Champion
Information:
**Cult Champion**

The cult champion is an elite warrior among their cult brethren, trained as a combatant rather than to perform their dark purposes. They are blessed with protections and charms that let them resist harm, as well as robes of bloody leather that can suppress physical trauma.

This stat block may be used as a template. The traits and actions of other cultists may be added to it to make the Cultist Champion more specifically themed, and its necrotic damage may be changed to a more appropriate damage type.

traits.name: Dread Leather
traits.description: The cultist wears specialized armor that was blessed as part of a ritual to their god. The armor, when worn by a follower of their deity, reduces all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage they take by 5 points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Dark Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target, or thrown as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus (1d8) necrotic damage. After being thrown, the spear vanishes and appears in the cultist’s hands.

bonus_actions.name: Devotion’s Reward (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.description: The cultist regains 27 (6d8) hit points and becomes resistant to all damage until the start of its next turn.
